headline: 82 ICC member states vote to dismiss prosecutor Karim Khan
summary: The decision follows allegations of sexual misconduct, which Khan has denied.
details: Member states of the International Criminal Court (ICC) voted on Friday to remove Karim Khan from his position as prosecutor.
According to two diplomatic sources speaking to Reuters, 82 of the court's 125 member states voted in favor of the dismissal.
The move comes after allegations of sexual misconduct were brought against the prosecutor.
Karim Khan has denied the allegations of misconduct.
caption:
82 out of 125 ICC member states have voted to remove prosecutor Karim Khan.

Member states of the International Criminal Court (ICC) voted on Friday to remove Karim Khan from his position as prosecutor.

According to two diplomatic sources speaking to Reuters, 82 of the court's 125 member states voted in favor of the dismissal.

The move comes after allegations of sexual misconduct were brought against the prosecutor.

Karim Khan has denied the allegations of misconduct.

headline_marked: Jamaat Ameer: [[Party is not a ‘party of angels’]], members can make mistakes
headline: Jamaat Ameer: Party is not a ‘party of angels’, members can make mistakes
summary: Opposition Leader Shafiqur Rahman acknowledges that party leaders and activists can commit offences and crimes, urging vigilance against moral misconduct.
details: Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer and Opposition Leader Shafiqur Rahman stated that his party is not a 'party of angels' and acknowledged that its members can make mistakes, commit offences, and commit crimes.
The remarks were made during the Dhaka district Jamaat-e-Islami's half-yearly members' (Rukon) conference at the IDEB auditorium.
Shafiqur Rahman urged party leaders and activists to remain vigilant, emphasizing that those in responsible positions must be even more careful regarding morality.
He stated that while tolerable lapses may be lead to reform, serious offences will result in strict action, asserting that there is no compromise on morality within the party.
The comments follow the recent expulsion of Satkhira-4 MP Gazi Nazrul Islam from the party after an investigation found evidence of 'moral misconduct'.
The party has called on citizens who love the country to report any wrongdoing or offence committed by its members.
caption:
“We are human beings, and we make mistakes.”

Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer Shafiqur Rahman admits party members can commit crimes.

Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer and Opposition Leader Shafiqur Rahman stated that his party is not a 'party of angels' and acknowledged that its members can make mistakes, commit offences, and commit crimes.

The remarks were made during the Dhaka district Jamaat-e-Islami's half-yearly members' (Rukon) conference at the IDEB auditorium.

Shafiqur Rahman urged party leaders and activists to remain vigilant, emphasizing that those in responsible positions must be even more careful regarding morality.

He stated that while tolerable lapses may be lead to reform, serious offences will result in strict action, asserting that there is no compromise on morality within the party.

The comments follow the recent expulsion of Satkhira-4 MP Gazi Nazrul Islam from the party after an investigation found evidence of 'moral misconduct'.

The party has called on citizens who love the country to report any wrongdoing or offence committed by its members.
